pages.text: The Zippermouth is the adult form of the much smaller $(l:hedges_bestiary:mobs/zipperling)Zipperling

While Zippermouths cannot be tamed, one can transmute a $(l:hedges_bestiary:mobs/zipperling)Zipperling$(/l) into a Zippermouth.$(br2)First one must find an adult zippermouth and feed it 1* $(treat3). The creature will shed one of its scales in gratitude, however it will not accept any more treats after that. Giving three of these scales to a zipperling turns it into a zippermouth.$(br2)Zippermouths can be ridden when tamed-- hold $(ability) to use suction
These great fish can displace huge amounts of water by opening their jaws
